evidence.description: REQ-A4 validator runs before any side-effect; SLOT presence and validate sub-command checked first
EDGE-E6 Darwin guard + REQ-A2 canonical-home pin both enforced before launchctl invocation
REQ-E2 cross-path collision detection with bootout
Negative test: override under $HOME/.cache rejected with exit 9 and 'must resolve under a temp root' on stderr
Negative test: non-executable override rejected with exit 9
Positive test: override inside tmp_path (= under /private/var/folders) accepted and emits the 'override active (test mode)' stderr line
pwd -P canonicalizes dirname BEFORE prefix check: LAUNCHCTL_BIN=/tmp/../etc/launchctl resolves to /etc -> rejected; /tmp/foo/../launchctl resolves to /private/tmp/launchctl -> accepted (correct)
Guard placement is BEFORE validation (L53), FS writes (L79), and any LAUNCHCTL invocation (L86) — no side-effect can run with a rejected override

Allow-list covers macOS canonical temp roots: $TMPDIR (with trailing slash stripped), /tmp, /private/tmp, /private/var/folders, /var/folders — matches the tmpdirs the existing Darwin integration tests use (test_collision_bootout_with_identical_disk_still_loads, test_bootstrap_failure_rolls_back_disk_plist still functional)
Executable bit re-checked on the canonicalized path so a non-x file under /tmp still dies loud
Stderr warning emitted whenever override is active — production callers cannot trigger silent substitution
Inline comment block names the finding (FIND-2-001) and the rationale — future maintainers see why the guard exists
Test module docstring explicitly names FIND-2-001 and what is being verified
Pure validator (lib.plist_render validate) invoked via subprocess with no FS/launchctl side-effect — purity boundary preserved
Pure render call (lib.plist_render render) keeps content generation in the pure core; shell shell only writes the returned bytes
Digest comparison also delegated to pure lib.plist_render digest
